```{r setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
})

summary_fs <- list.files(".", pattern = "^cb_summary_.+\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
labels_fs  <- list.files(".", pattern = "^cb_barcode_labels_.+\\.csv\\.gz$", full.names = TRUE)

if (length(summary_fs) == 0) {
  stop("No cb_summary_*.csv files found")
}

sample_id_from <- function(fs, prefix, suffix) {
  sub(suffix, "", sub(paste0("^.*/", prefix), "", fs))
}

names(summary_fs) <- sample_id_from(summary_fs, "cb_summary_", "\\.csv$")
names(labels_fs)  <- sample_id_from(labels_fs, "cb_barcode_labels_", "\\.csv\\.gz$")

summary_dt <- rbindlist(lapply(summary_fs, fread), fill = TRUE)
summary_dt <- summary_dt[order(sample_id)]

labels_ls <- lapply(labels_fs, fread)
```

## Summary

```{r summary-table}
summary_view <- summary_dt[, .(
  sample_id,
  estimated_cells,
  cellbender_called,
  overlap_barcodes,
  estimated_only,
  cellbender_only,
  jaccard_index,
  called_over_estimated_ratio,
  total_droplets_included,
  low_count_threshold
)]

knitr::kable(summary_view, digits = 3)
```

## Estimated vs Called

```{r compare-bars}
plot_dt <- melt(
  summary_dt[, .(sample_id, estimated_cells, cellbender_called, overlap_barcodes)],
  id.vars = "sample_id",
  variable.name = "metric",
  value.name = "n"
)

plot_dt[, metric := factor(metric, levels = c("estimated_cells", "cellbender_called", "overlap_barcodes"))]

labs <- c(
  estimated_cells = "Estimated (barcode step)",
  cellbender_called = "Called by CellBender",
  overlap_barcodes = "Overlap"
)


ggplot(plot_dt, aes(x = sample_id, y = n, fill = metric)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", labels = labs) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Barcodes", fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -45, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5))
```

## Per-sample Breakdown

```{r per-sample-tabset, results='asis'}
cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")

for (sid in summary_dt$sample_id) {
  cat("### ", sid, "\n\n", sep = "")

  this_summary <- summary_dt[sample_id == sid]
  this_labels <- labels_ls[[sid]]

  this_counts <- this_labels[, .N, by = class][order(class)]
  if (!"class" %in% names(this_counts)) {
    this_counts <- data.table(class = c("overlap", "estimated_only", "cellbender_only"), N = c(0, 0, 0))
  }

  cat("**Sample metrics**\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(this_summary[, .(
    estimated_cells,
    cellbender_called,
    overlap_barcodes,
    estimated_only,
    cellbender_only,
    jaccard_index,
    called_over_estimated_ratio
  )], digits = 3))
  cat("\n\n")

  g <- ggplot(this_counts, aes(x = class, y = N, fill = class)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Barcodes", title = sid) +
    theme_classic()

  print(g)
  cat("\n\n")
}

cat("::: \n")
```

## Ratios

```{r ratios}
ratio_dt <- summary_dt[, .(
  sample_id,
  jaccard_index,
  called_over_estimated_ratio
)]

ratio_long <- melt(ratio_dt, id.vars = "sample_id", variable.name = "metric", value.name = "value")

ratio_labels <- c(
  jaccard_index = "Jaccard overlap",
  called_over_estimated_ratio = "Called / estimated"
)

ratio_long[, metric := factor(metric, levels = names(ratio_labels), labels = ratio_labels)]

ggplot(ratio_long, aes(x = sample_id, y = value, color = metric, group = metric)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.01)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Ratio", color = NULL) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -45, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5))
```
